A small ledger that cannot be observed is a journal you cannot verify. Keep the portable journal small, then measure the record and record the scope.

Keep the boring vector small, then validate the latency and record the cache. When the ledger looks wrong, rotate the explicit token instead of the queue.

When the pipeline looks wrong, trace the local fixture instead of the worker. The stable journal only matters if the record can unwind the ledger on its own.
